name: Counter-TS-TW
blurb: Digit-by-digit animated number counter with sliding digits and gradient overlays.
description: Sophisticated number counter using Framer Motion where each digit scrolls independently. Supports custom formatting, automatic place detection, and decorative gradient masks. Highly configurable styling and animation.
use_when: Displaying counts or metrics where per-digit animation creates a premium feel.
avoid_when: Simple number displays or performance-critical contexts where per-digit animation is overhead.
a11y: Animated digits are visually-only; consider adding static number text for screen readers.
